d: Ukraine is preparing for renewed peace talks as Russia intensifies attacks on Kyiv and battlefield pressure grows. Russian President Vladimir Putin has backed, in principle, a US proposal for talks involving Russia, Ukraine and the United States, potentially in Abu Dhabi. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky says Kyiv is willing to freeze fighting along the current frontline and move to negotiations, but he rejects surrendering the Donbas. Ukraine is also facing shortages of Patriot interceptors and disruption to its Starshield access, leaving it in a weaker position as diplomacy gathers…
